Additionally, Cohen et al. (2010) identified two clusters that are
made up of the five areas of aggression:
1. Overt Aggression cluster (composed of Physical aggression
against objects, Physical aggression against other people, and
Verbal Aggression Toward Others areas of aggression)
2. Self Destructive cluster (composed of Physical aggression against
self and Verbal aggression toward self)
These are presented as an average score between 0 - 3, calculated

items. Average scores allow for comparison between the two
clusters to determine if aggression is more overt or self-destructive
